$comment: Scoring rules. Per bag: points = base + sum(addPoints); mult = 1 + behaviourAdd, then charms in slot order (addMult adds, mulMult multiplies), then x weapon x Frenzy x Stampede; award = round(points * mult). Event bonuses are multiplied only by eventBonusMultipliers. Full rule: docs/01-GAME-DESIGN.md section 5.3.

planes.$comment: D-049 (perspective): scale sizes everything on a plane (art, hitboxes, spacing, speeds via tuningRefScale). minHitRadiusPx floors the body hit radii for every input (far 18, Ver 10) so small far birds stay shootable; touch aimAssistPx mid 10 / far 12 (was 14 / 18: the floor already widens far birds); far base 25 -> 22 keeps competent Classic within +2 %. Numbers: docs/balance/perspective.md.

ver.$comment: v1.3 (D-036): the distant band behind the far plane, on the strip at the foot of the far ridge. Only rifles reach it (weapons.json reachesVer); birds are a few px unzoomed. Shows only on maps that open it (Nog Verder, Die Verste).

stampede.$comment: Single source of truth for the Stampede. Enabled in these modes; Season Run only via the stampede_kenner charm.

aimAssistLevels.$comment: Settings → aim assist (touch only): multiplier on planes.*.aimAssistPx. Mouse is always 0.
